limitations: Single manufacturer, one category, model-level identities without size-specific claims.
Conflict, variant and prompt-injection cases are covered in a separately identified synthetic supplement.
Official dynamic PDFs contain retrieval-date metadata; changed downloads require explicit dataset review, never silently replace pinned bytes.
review_notes: A060 has an unlabeled ": 12" below Materials. It is excluded from the material and is not inferred as an inner or outer pack count.
A146 explicitly states both 15-gauge and 10-gauge liners; value-bound citations allow either stated layer.
Finished glove length remains unknown; A631/A632 give cuff extension only and page-2 tables give carton dimensions.
Some original manufacturer PDFs have malformed headers or clipped labels. The original bytes are retained; pypdf extraction and Poppler rendering were checked.
